description: Task class to cognitive-spend routing. Tiers and efforts are the neutral modelchk scale (fast|standard|frontier, glance|measured|thorough|exhaustive). No vendor or model names here: the harness binds tiers to whatever models the user runs. Closed questions go to the decision model (TypeSafe Jev) or to plain code before any language model.

decision_model.use_for: closed questions only: choose one option, score on a rubric, yes/no. One request per preflight with every question attached.

classes.note: path prefix first; jev Choice only when 0 or 2+ candidates
explicit rules first; jev Score; unmatched or unknown -> confirm
version compare first; jev Noul only strengthens a stale rationale
exact name first; jev Choice with confidence and margin gates
duplicate lesson? secret present? before any draft is written
renames, frontmatter fields, file moves with complete verification
codebase or docs investigation, no writes
rewrite one Procedure from one fetched official document; input is that pair only
after note-triage says new and secret-free
raise to frontier when crossing ownership or touching secrets
must run on a different model than the one that produced the artifact

rules: Escalate one tier only when verification cannot prove the cheaper result.
Review by a model different from the author; same model reviewing itself does not count.
Language models receive the selected note and evidence only, never the whole cache.
A decision-model answer below its confidence threshold falls to the safe side, never to auto.
